    Anosi Ledger-Weight¶

    [!INFO] Weighed on Paper — Counted to the Copper The counting-house measure of the Anos Plutocracy — not struck in iron but written in ledgers. A weight that exists because a clerk in basalt says it does.

    Base Units¶

    Anos keeps bronze standard weights in the vaults of Anos proper — Ounce, Pound, Stone, Hundredweight, Ton — each bored and plugged with Romanium dust, verified each equinox against the Ledger Bar (a platinum bar, copy of the Erisian vault bar, but Anos claims theirs did not shrink). Anos deliberately mirrors the Erisian table so no merchant needs two sets. The difference is trust, not length: a Vennerian pound is weighed on a Vennerian scale; an Anosi pound is weighed on an Anosi promise.

    What makes Anosi distinct is not the table but the ledger overlay — tallies, scores, and enterprise units built atop the imperial base.

    Domain Unit Relation Notes
    Weight (base) Grain base as Erisian
    Pennyweight 24 Grains assay
    Ounce 20 Pennyweights counting-house Ounce, 28.35 g
    Pound 16 Ounces ledger-pound — 453.6 g. Basis for Anosi Mark receipts
    Stone 14 Pounds 6.35 kg — but Anos Stone 13.8 lb in older contracts (see below)
    Hundredweight 8 Stone
    Ton 20 Hundredweight ledgers distinguish weight Ton (2,240 lb) vs. cargo Ton (freight volume — stolen from Venner)
    Ledger Count Tally 5 Score 100 units — a counting-house line
    Score 20 units vigesimal remnant
    Gross 12 Dozen 144 — bulk cloth, spices
    Great-Gross 12 Gross 1,728
    Bale variable the Bale — standardized to 120 Pounds grain-equivalent for customs. 1 Bale = invoice unit
    Cargo 10 Bales 1,200 Pounds — ledger cargo. 2 Cargo = 1 Vennerian register Ton (by treaty at Beast's Bay)
    Volume Pint base as Erisian
    Gallon 8 Pints
    Bushel 8 Gallons grain tithe — but Anos Bushel is 8.5 Erisian Gallons for export (the Carver's margin)
    Length as Erisian — Anos uses Erisian Foot/Yard/Chain on land. We count weight, Venner measures the sea

    The old Stone: pre-511 AGD contracts use Anosi Old Stone = 13.8 Pounds (6.26 kg). Post-reform Stone = 14.0. Clerks mark OS vs NS. Lawsuits persist at Grimmel.

    Who Uses¶

    The Anos Plutocracy and its network — Anos capital, Lumina Outpost, Marti, Xeti, New Kolorad (Kumir), Komme and Tatak (Dissenbarg coalitions), Anos Maloca, and quietly in Grimmel merchant quarter and Kreb (Sousu). Also the universal second set of books at Beast's Bay: every Vennerian manifest has an Anosi conversion in the margin, in a smaller hand.

    Bankers, spice factors, grain brokers, and any trader who prefers a receipt to a weight.

    Conversion Notes¶

    • To Erisian Standard: Numerical parity by design. 1 Anosi Pound = 1 Erisian Pound by definition since 511 AGD reform. Before that, 1 Anosi Old Stone = 0.986 Erisian Stone — the reform was an admission.
    • To Vennerian Cable & Knot: Anos keeps weight Ton (2,240 lb) and cargo Ton (volume, 40 cu ft) as separate ledger columns. Vennerian register Ton = Anosi cargo Ton exactly — agreed 389 AGD at Beast's Bay to stop the lawsuits (it did not).
    • To Dwarven Stone: 1 Anosi Pound = 0.98 Dwarven Pounds. Dwarven guilds refuse Anosi plug-weights (hollow, they say).
    • Bale trick: 1 Anosi Bale = 120 Pounds grain-equivalent even when the bale contains silk, spices, or Romanium filings. Anosi customs duty is per Bale, not per Pound — so dense goods gain on paper. This is intentional and counts as a feature, not a bug, for Anos revenue.
    • Romanium: Romanium is booked in Anosi ledger-pounds against the Anosi Mark receipt (A₥). 1 ledger-pound Romanium = 1 Anosi Mark base receipt. The coin is paper over gold because the weight is paper over iron.

    Flavor¶

    Anosi measure is polite fiction made profitable. The bronze Pound in the vault is real, but no one on the quay weighs with it — they weigh with the clerk's word that the weight is correct, and the clerk is bonded, and the bond is insured, and the insurance is reinsured. Three ledgers confirm one Pound more reliably than one scale.

    Merchants joke: Venner weighs, Anos counts, the farmer pays for both. A factor who can convert Old Stone to New Stone to Vennerian register Ton to Dwarven Stone in his head makes factor-master in a year. Those who cannot make excellent customers.

    The saying at Beast's Bay: Trust the Vennerian rope; audit the Anosi receipt.
